limits: Development tier; no release matrix or physical-hardware qualification.
Two sessions maximum; eight public Task slots remain fixed. Separate desktop shell windows are not implemented.
Close remains cooperative. Noncooperative work retains its session until it returns.
Switch clocks are interrupt-checkpoint observations with PAL frame resolution and scanout fences, not pure CPU timings.
Output workload interleaves one visible ECHO with eight NIL reports; both peers make progress and the producer stays active throughout the cohort.
Slot stack watermarks accumulate across lifetimes. Per-checkpoint live identities and slots are recorded; no isolated per-incarnation peak is inferred.
Mixed SIO+IDE adds one transport worker; IDE-only substitutes it. These final variant counts are structural, not new IDE qualification runs.
